title: "O5 Assess needs and priorities for methods research"
link-citations: true
---

## Definition
These studies aim to assess the gaps and needs for future methods research, sometimes ranked by priority.

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Quantitative surveys](../approaches/6survey.qmd): identify priorities for retention research;[@Kearney2017identifying] identify priorities for methods research in the context of global health;[@Rosala-Hallas2018global] needs for methodological guidance on blinding in complex-intervention trials.[@Yonis2025-dw]

[Consensus studies](../approaches/8consensus.qmd): Delphi study to identify priorities for methods research.[@TudurSmith2014the]

[Reviews of applied or planned methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): identify research needs in individual participant-data meta-analysis.[@Seidler2026-uh]
